end.summary:
Vihaan practised the hierarchy of courts: District Court → High Court → Supreme Court, and the idea of appeal.
They connected appeals with reviewing a decision, using an umpire/DRS comparison.
They identified theft and a hit-and-run as criminal cases and a property dispute as a civil case.
They remained unsure about who starts a criminal case and did not pass the teach-back.
end.parentNote: Vihaan practised the court hierarchy and appeal pathway, and used examples to sort civil and criminal cases. They correctly identified the property dispute as civil and theft and hit-and-run as criminal. The mix-up about the role of the police in criminal cases was not corrected by the end of the lesson (correctAfterLastSeen: false). At home, practise with two short examples: a property disagreement for civil cases and a theft report for criminal cases, including who reports it and why.
